title: Web: strength trend
description: Whether lifting is improving overall, as of the day shown (fa_coach/strength_trend.py). Over the last `days` days: each counting lift (not excluded, not paused) with at least 2 sessions in the window (from its latest baseline reset), its heaviest working set as estimated 1RM (effective load for bodyweight lifts); per ISO week its best value as % change from its first session in the window; a week's point is the mean over the lifts trained by then, each carrying its last value forward. change_pct is the last point; direction: flat within ±band_pct, else rising or falling. Null change_pct and direction when no lift qualifies.

points.description: One per ISO week touching the window, oldest first; change_pct null before any counted lift was trained.
